sampling: 20 deterministic hash-ranked unique candidates from the initial rule; review found repeated-comparative counterexample before the full run

decisions.text: Are people out there finding true and lasting love through the Internet
decisions.note: Lasting modifies love alongside true. The turn asks whether people find it; it does not assert successful relationships for all users. The missing final question mark does not change its interrogative syntax.

decisions.text: Yet Julia is not a patch on Anne because she's not as diligent and clever as Anne.
decisions.note: Clever and diligent both describe Julia in a negated comparison with Anne. Do not turn not as ... as into a positive trait assertion or a categorical absence of either quality.

decisions.text: Drinking warm and fresh water in the morning on wakening up is one of ways to keep healthy.
decisions.note: Warm and fresh modify water. This is a generic health claim made by the speaker, not evidence of a particular drinking event or validation of that claim.

decisions.text: We have black, white and transparent panty-hose here.
decisions.note: Black, white and transparent denote varieties of pantyhose on offer. The shared noun target does not mean every individual pair has all three properties.

decisions.text: Do you remember the dress we saw at Mayors that was so beautiful and expensive?
decisions.note: Expensive shares the relative subject that with beautiful, referring to the dress. The subsequent half-price purchase is a separate clause with its own time and price.

decisions.text: She's smart and enthusiastic.
decisions.note: Enthusiastic and smart concern Mary. The later speaker names weaknesses; preserve who makes each evaluation rather than merging them into a universally agreed profile.

decisions.text: We are more interested in finding someone who is alert and quick at figures.
decisions.note: Quick at figures and alert qualify a desired employee. This does not establish that the current applicant meets either requirement or has been hired.

decisions.text: I tend to work well with people who are confident and straightforward.
decisions.note: Straightforward and confident modify people with whom the speaker tends to work well. No particular colleague is identified by this clause.

decisions.text: Nowadays, men are spending more and more time in the kitchen.
decisions.note: More and more time expresses an increase. Excluded from automatic coordination repair; it needs a degree/quantity construction rather than two independent properties.

decisions.text: But I'm sick and tired of all the office power struggles!
decisions.note: Sick and tired of office struggles expresses frustration. The target is the speaker, but the phrase must not become evidence of literal illness plus physical fatigue. Quitting remains an intention.

decisions.text: He's all nice and friendly to my face.
decisions.note: Nice and friendly describe Tim only in his behavior to the speaker face to face. The following report of sabotage restricts the interpretation; it is not an unconditional character assessment.

decisions.text: I am knowledgeable and levelheaded.
decisions.note: Knowledgeable and levelheaded are the interviewee's self-described strengths. No completed work event follows from those attributes.

decisions.text: The toilet flushes and the shower has hot and cold water
decisions.note: Hot and cold water describes the available supplies/settings. A shared noun target does not imply the same water is simultaneously hot and cold.

decisions.text: A reading knowledge of a language is larger and different from a writing knowledge.
decisions.note: Larger and different compare reading knowledge with writing knowledge. Preserve the comparison complement; do not transfer the properties to the person.

decisions.text: Thank goodness we're not rich and famous!
decisions.note: Not scopes rich and famous. Do not assert either trait positively. The next speaker's willingness to be rich is a desire, not a present wealth claim.

decisions.text: Whatever you choose, make sure they are neat and clean.
decisions.note: Neat and clean specify the desired condition of the clothes. Make sure is an instruction; it does not establish their current condition.

decisions.text: Yes, flexible, aggressive and creative people are urgently needed in the marketing department.
decisions.note: Flexible, aggressive and creative qualify the people needed in marketing. The later plan to transfer James does not prove he has all these qualities or has already moved.

decisions.text: Well, he's very tall and handsome.
decisions.note: Tall and handsome describe the same man. Preserve very on tall; its degree must not automatically be copied to handsome.

decisions.text: I never knew Thai food was so creative and delicious!
decisions.note: Creative and delicious concern Thai food. Never knew describes the speaker's earlier lack of awareness, not a negation of deliciousness; the surrounding tasting motivates a current favorable evaluation.

decisions.text: That's nice and easy.
decisions.note: That points to the described repayment/application arrangement, evaluated as nice and easy. No completed loan, application approval or repayment is asserted.

scope: Syntactic attachment and listed contextual meanings only. This file is not a fully reviewed import annotation or an SFT dataset.
